Spout: fills the item under it (on a depot or belt), fed by pipes. Item Drain: items rolled across it from the side are emptied into it; right-click it to pour your held bucket or bottle in; pipes pull from it; drains can be chained

Rotation lowers the hose (reverse to raise it); pipes on its side fill or drain the pool (draining top-down, filling bottom-up). In a body of 10,000+ blocks of water or lava (an ocean, a big Nether lava sea) it is bottomless: infinite water or lava without using the source up

A movement anchor (piston, bearing, pulley, gantry, cart assembler, station) moves the block in front; Super Glue makes more blocks move with it: click two corners to glue the box between (click again to confirm, sneak + click to discard), punch a box with glue to remove it; touching glued areas move together; blocks hanging on others (torches, ladders) need none

Linear and radial chassis move a line or a radius of blocks: right-click a face with a slime ball to make it sticky (sneak + empty hand removes), a wrench sets the range (hold Ctrl to change all connected chassis); Cyber Goggles lets you toggle sticky faces with an empty hand (unverified on the server)
Up to 2,048 blocks; obsidian and reinforced deepslate never move; spawners and budding amethyst move but stop a minecart contraption being picked up; blocks placed by the Mason's Palette won't move
When a piston, pulley or bearing stops, its structure turns back into blocks; its value box can make that happen only at its start position (or angle), or never until the anchor is broken

Mechanical Piston: needs extension poles behind it (poles = reach, max 64); speed and direction follow the rotation; a sticky one pulls back. Rope Pulley: moves its structure up and down (rope up to 384); other pulleys on the same layer join in (looks only); a pulley moves with a contraption only while stopped

Mechanical Bearing: rotates the structure in front; a bearing riding a moving structure keeps itself upright. Clockwork Bearing: turns like an hour hand with the time of day (a second, unglued structure in front becomes the minute hand); right-click to start or stop

A Gantry Carriage slides along a Gantry Shaft carrying blocks; shafts attach to carriages without glue, so gantries stack for X, Y and Z movement; direction depends on the shaft's orientation and its rotation

Drills, saws, harvesters, ploughs, rollers and deployers work as they move; chests and barrels on board collect drops and supply deployers and rollers; dispensers, droppers, bells and campfires also act; Contraption Controls switch them

Two PSIs facing each other with a 1-2 block gap connect when a contraption passes: the fixed one then acts as every inventory on the contraption (funnels and chutes in or out); the contraption waits until nothing has moved for 3 s; redstone stops it docking. Portable Fluid Interface does the same for tanks

The first one placed starts a network; right-click an existing link with a new one before placing to join it; packagers with links share their inventory. Range is unlimited but packages still need transport. Put a tuned item in a crafting grid to reset it

Chain conveyors: right-click two with chains to join them (up to 32 blocks, 4 links each, 20 packages per chain); they also carry rotation and connect to shafts above or below. Right-click a conveyor with a Frogport, place it nearby (5 blocks) and give it an address: packages for another address go onto the chain and find the matching frog; it works with the inventory or packager below it; packages with no match circle
Right-click a Train Station with a Postbox, place it nearby, give it an address; trains whose schedule says Deliver or Retrieve Package carry packages between postboxes, even in unloaded chunks

Tune it to a Stock Link (right-click the link before placing) and place it on a Packager: right-click with the item to watch, hold right-click to set the target amount, open it to set the address; when the inventory drops below target the network sends more

Placed anywhere else a gauge watches the whole network's stock of its item: add gauges for the ingredients and connect them in its screen, set the address where it's made and the output per batch; it orders ingredients whenever stock is below target (green lines = target met). "Use Mechanical Crafting" sends arranged packages straight into a wrench-connected 3x3 crafter grid; a Re-Packager keeps packages whole

Tune it to a Stock Link before placing; set an order in it (or right-click a Stock Keeper with it and order there); every pulse sends that order; choose "Allow partial orders" or "Must send all items". Cyber Goggles adds JEI's + to fill it from a recipe (hold Alt for a plain crafting grid)
Send all fragments of an order to an inventory with a powered Re-Packager: it re-wraps them into one package once every part has arrived
Right-click frogports or postboxes with a Clipboard to note their addresses; clipboard entries starting with # auto-complete address fields in other screens

Breaks the block in front, faster with more RPM; on a contraption it mines whatever it runs into, into the contraption's chests. Breaks up to Hardness tier II (gold and redstone ore yes; diamond, emerald, obsidian no). Pack: Mining 15 to make

A bearing, piston, gantry, cart or train with drills and a chest is an automatic miner: Contraption Controls switch the drills, a PSI empties it without stopping, scheduled trains keep going but don't mine in unloaded chunks

On a contraption: Clear and Pave (breaks blocks like a drill, then lays the material set in its filter, taken from attached chests), Straight Fill or Sloped Fill (fills gaps below down to 12 blocks without breaking anything); set the mode while it's not moving. Some blocks it breaks drop nothing
Mines the block 2 in front, up to Hardness tier II

Underground layers of veridium, crimsite, asurine and ochrum: crushing them gives copper (80%), iron (40%), zinc (30%) and gold (20%) as crushed ore plus nuggets. They're stone, not ore, so no Hardness tome is needed (unverified)
Crushing ores (and other Create steps) gives Nuggets of Experience: right-click to get the experience (vanilla XP, for enchanting); 9 make a Block of Experience
rows.docs: MISSING (lifesteal.md uses them in a recipe)

rows.how: In the off-hand: +3 blocks of reach for your main hand (+5 holding one in each hand), and melee hits further away with extra knockback (exact attack range unverified). Uses durability (200), or with a backtank worn its air (1,000 actions a tank)

Cyber Goggles' default makes the game treat you as always wearing Engineer's Goggles (in every game mode): look at any Create block for speed, stress, contents, boiler status and more, and keep your helmet slot for armour. Turn off: \ -> Goggles -> Game Mode
rows.docs: MISSING (create.md: goggles show speed and stress)

rows.how: Cyber Goggles: hold Left Shift while looking at any kinetic block to add its whole network's speed, stress and remaining capacity (like a stressometer anywhere)

Cyber Goggles adds belt throughput, fan push/pull range, blaze burner state and time left, crushing wheel and millstone progress and outputs, deployer overflow, depot and basin contents, schematicannon progress, pulse progress, with 2 decimals
Cyber Goggles draws info about the item on the block you look at; on a block with several (a table cloth shop) hold Left Ctrl and scroll to pick which; theme and colours in its config

Press \ : Goggles (enhanced info, precise numbers, hide static info, game modes), Tooltip (which item tooltips show contents), Overlay (theme, colours, drafting view), Outliner (analog boxes, connection lines), Misc (wrench, chain conveyor, stock keeper, JEI, sound pool). Options marked "may be considered cheating on server" are best left as they are
ESC -> HUD Layout moves and resizes it; Create's own /create overlay opens a drag preview (Esc saves), /create overlay reset puts it back

Mods -> Create -> Config (or Create's button on the pause screen, position on the pack's board unverified): client settings; server settings are shown read-only (belt length, train speeds...); Ctrl + F searches

Tooltips, overstressed hint, fan particle density, filter item render distance, turning with a seated contraption (rotateWhenSeated), goggle overlay colours, machine ambient sounds and their volume cap, stock keeper and JEI search sync, camera distance on trains (mountedZoomMultiplier 3), train map overlay and its colour (RED / GREY / WHITE)
Mods -> Ponder -> Config: Comfy Reading (slows scenes while text shows), placement assist indicator type and size

JEI shows Create's processing by machine: Bulk Washing / Smoking / Blasting / Haunting (fan + catalyst), Crushing, Milling, Pressing, Compacting, Mixing (with heat level), Sawing, Deploying, Spout Filling, Item Draining, Manual Item Application, Sandpaper Polishing, Sequenced Assembly, Mechanical Crafting, Automated Brewing, Mysterious Conversion; press U on a machine for everything it does
Create JEI Compat: recipes with 7+ steps show 6 per page with a page number; scroll or arrow keys turn pages; clickable arrows: config/createjeicompat-client.toml showPageArrows = true
Lists random-salvage contents of sequenced assembly; allows mechanical-crafting recipes bigger than 3x3 in stock requests (its warning: a Re-Packager can swallow items with those)

Drill Mining 15, saw Woodcutting 15, harvester and plough Farming 15, encased fan Cooking 20, mechanical crafter Crafting 30, schematicannon Construction 30, steam engine Smithing 35, station and controls Agility 35; anyone can use one a friend made
Mechanical crafters, mixers and presses (basins) won't make anything a skill gates or use a gated recipe; the mixer won't brew past Brewing 1
Drilling, sawing, harvesting, fan cooking or smelting, crushing and crafting by Create machines (deployers included) train nobody's skills: mine, chop and cook by hand to level

rows.feature: Machine placements pay no Construction XP
rows.how: Blocks placed by deployers or the schematicannon pay no Construction XP; only blocks you place yourself do

rows.feature: No claims: guard your Create stuff
rows.how: With no claims, anyone can sneak-wrench your machines into their own inventory in a moment, use your toolbox from 10 blocks (Left Alt), pick up minecart contraptions, read your trains on the world map, and order from your stock network unless it's locked
rows.docs: MISSING (world.md says there are no claims)

rows.how: In the Stock Keeper screen click the lock: other players can no longer order directly or tune new links into it ("Logistics Network is Protected"); shops on it still sell through shopping lists

Sell to other players while you're offline, priced in any item (Gold Coins): shop inventory + Packager + Stock Link, a Stock Ticker with a seated keeper; hold a Table Cloth and right-click the keeper to make a trade, place the cloth, put the price in the slot on its side; buyers right-click cloths to fill a Shopping List and hand it to the keeper; bought items come out packaged and payments collect in the stock ticker (how high a coin price can go is unverified)

Hardness tomes II-V, the gear sets, warp stones and waystones are made in mechanical crafters; warp dust and grave essence are mixed over a blaze burner; Hearts are sequenced assembly; backpack tiers use Create parts
Blocks placed by a schematicannon or moved by contraptions are not removed when you're eliminated

Mods -> Nowheel -> Config: Tick culling (skips animating hidden Create machines; off by default, turn on for FPS, off again if something stops animating), Distance culling (culls what Entity Culling can't trace; helps at render distance 8+; off by default), Override Entity Culling limits (on, needs a restart), Force removing backend (only if FPS dropped after an update)
Create's machines are drawn by Flywheel: /flywheel backend shows or sets the backend, /flywheel limitUpdates toggles distance-limited animation updates; config/flywheel-client.toml lightSmoothness
With shaders on, Flywheel can't use its fast instanced path (the pack has no Colorwheel), so big Create bases cost more FPS (unverified)
/create clearRenderBuffers redraws contraptions that render wrong; /create fixLighting fixes lighting glitches
Cyber Goggles: export a schematic as an image (1024 px, hold Shift for 2048) from its preview, or /ccg schematic export <file> [width] [orientation] [antialiasing]
Cyber Goggles config -> Overlay -> Drafting View: a pixelated, outlined blueprint look over the whole screen (off by default; pixel scale and line colour adjustable)
Hold Left Shift while the cursor is over a relic in a menu: opens its page (description, stats, abilities, experience sources, options)

rows.feature: Relic page only from your own inventory
rows.how: The research page refuses relics sitting in a chest, backpack or other container ("Working with a relic in this inventory is not possible"); move the relic into your main inventory first

Hold Left Alt: a ring of cards for your equipped relics' switchable abilities opens; move the mouse to a card and left-click to cast it or flip its mode (On/Off, Midnight Mantle's Full/New Moon); scroll or the arrows page through more

rows.feature: Hold Shift to repeat relic actions
rows.how: On a relic page, hold Shift while clicking Level Up (spends XP/points until they run out), Reroll (rerolls until max quality or XP runs out) or the research Hint (fully automatic research)

Relics' ability wheel, Create's "Access nearby toolboxes", Copycats+ and Cyber Goggles all default to Left Alt; next to a toolbox both menus can react (unverified). Rebind one in Controls if it bothers you

rows.feature: Sneak to chop a single log
rows.how: With the Lumber Axe, sneak while breaking a log and only that log breaks (FallingTree sneakMode SNEAK_DISABLE). Use it on log walls, log builds and Create machinery

Press `-` (chat says "Break Speed Perk Disabled/Enabled"): turns off the +0.5 %/level Mining, Woodcutting and Farming dig-speed bonus, e.g. when you break blocks too fast for careful work, or turn it back on

Craft string over leather. Holds one stack's worth of mixed items. In a menu: right-click an item onto the bundle to put it in; hover the bundle and scroll to pick an item, right-click to take that one out. Dye it at a crafting table. Also in village chests

Relics wear in Curios slots (G): one head, necklace, back (mantles), belt, ring, feet and charm slot, so only one mantle and one boot relic at a time (the Climbing Boots share the feet slot with Roller Skate, Springy Boot and Cut Glass Boot). Kinetic Belt and Hunting Belt add charm slots. Chorus Staff, Clot of Time, Shield of Retaliation, Sphere of Self-Sacrifice and Rider Flute work from your hand, not a slot
rows.docs: MISSING (gear.md says relics "go in their own slots")

rows.how: Macaw's drawers, wardrobes, cabinets, drawer/cupboard counters and bookshelf drawers each hold 27 slots ("Furniture Inventory"); right-click to open. They expose an item handler, so hoppers and Create funnels can fill and empty them (unverified per block)
Farmer's Delight cabinets (every wood, modded woods via Every Compat): 27-slot storage like a barrel; comparators read how full it is
Farmer's Delight basket (placeable facing any way): collects items dropped into its opening and pushes them into the container it faces; a redstone signal pauses it; comparator reads its contents
9 carrots, potatoes, beetroots, cabbages, tomatoes or onions craft into a crate; rice into a Bag of Rice, rice panicles into a Rice Bale, straw into a Straw Bale; craft back into 9
Woodworks chests and trapped chests come in every wood (Bamboo Closet; two make a Large Closet); a chest crafted from mixed planks is still a plain chest
Macaw's roofs, windows, paths, bridges, stairs, fences, lights, doors and furniture pay 15 Construction XP a block once placed for a minute
Right-click a Macaw's chair, stool, couch or chaise to sit; couches connect side by side
Tables, desks, counters, wardrobes and couches placed next to each other merge into wider or taller pieces
Right-click with a water bucket to fill it (one bucket); take the water back with a bucket or a glass bottle

Right-click any Macaw's lamp, lantern, chandelier, ceiling light or torch to turn it off/on; lamps, street lamps, tiki torches and ceiling lights can be stacked as tall as you like; paper lamps and other dyeables recolour with a right-click of dye; light tiki torches with flint and steel
Right-click a Macaw's window with the Window Hammer to change its shape
Right-click a window with the Window Key to lock it so it can't be opened (on a server with no claims it keeps windows shut; who can unlock it is unverified)
One Way Glass and its pane: see out from one side only. Place it facing out for a window nobody can see in through
Arrow Slit blocks (stone, dark, end) for shooting out of a wall
Right-click to open, close or tie them; blinds cycle raised/closed/open and neighbouring blinds follow; shutters open in pairs
Right-click the top roof piece with the Roofing Hammer to cycle its shape
Gutters fill with water while it rains; take water out with a bucket or a glass bottle; dye the gutter base
Bridge pieces join into sides and corners as you place them; right-click a 2+ wide bridge with Pliers (or shears) to cut an entrance; bridge torches and lanterns go on the handrails
Railings go on the side of any stairs, vanilla or modded; shears cycle the railing/balcony style; up to 4 balconies on one block; platforms make stair corners
Macaw's fences and walls stack upward to make taller ones; hedges are leaf fences
Wired and stone wired fences hurt anything that walks into them, like cactus (mob and raider barrier)
Right-click Macaw's paving with a pickaxe to engrave it, with a shovel to flatten it
Woodworks Sawmill: a stonecutter for wood (logs and planks into stairs, slabs, boards, ladders and more; JEI category "Sawing")
Bookshelves, chiseled bookshelves, ladders, beehives, boards and leaf piles in every wood (Woodworks); beehives in every wood (Friends&Foes too)

Every Compat copies Macaw's Furniture, Woodworks blocks, Farmer's Delight cabinets and Create windows into every modded wood (Regions Unexplored's maple, redwood, willow...). Macaw's roofs, windows, doors, fences, lights, paths, bridges, stairs and trapdoors stay vanilla woods only (pack choice)
Farmer's Delight canvas signs and hanging canvas signs: dye them at a crafting table for a coloured background (dark ones default to white text)
Canvas rugs, tatami mats and straw bales for floors
Potion of Reaching (brewed with a crab claw, from crabs on beaches and swamps; base potion unverified): +1 block reach for building

Build a tuff block, any wool and a carved pumpkin stacked in that order: the Tuff Golem holds and shows an item you give it (right-click), naps, and wanders while awake; right-click it with honeycomb to glue it in place, with an axe to unglue it
Pale oak wood set (Pale Garden), resin bricks (smelt resin clumps into resin bricks), resin as an armour-trim material, pale moss, eyeblossoms (orange/gray dye)
Leaf litter (smelt any leaves; up to 4 layers per block), wildflowers (yellow dye), bushes, firefly bushes (fireflies at night), cactus flowers (pink dye, grow on cactus), short and tall dry grass
Sulfur, cinnabar and their polished/brick/chiseled families from Sulfur Caves (4 sulfur spikes make 4 sulfur)
Shellstone family, froglass blocks and panes (dragonfly drops), bear plush, snail shells (dye them)

Craft a Dried Ghast (8 ghast tears round a soul sand) or find one (Nether fossils, piglin bartering). Place it in water (waterlogged): it rehydrates in stages and becomes a ghastling, which grows into a happy ghast (snowballs feed it; growth speed-up unverified)

rows.feature: Harness and ride a happy ghast
rows.how: Craft a harness (3 leather over glass, wool, glass; the wool sets the colour) and right-click the happy ghast with it. Up to 4 players ride; the first rider steers: W flies the way you look (look up or down to climb or dive), Space rises. Shears take the harness off
A harnessed happy ghast holds still while a player stands on top of it: a flying scaffold for building high up. It can also hold leads, so leashed animals ride along
Saddle: a leather over leather, iron ingot, leather (3 leather + 1 iron ingot). Leads: 5 string make 2, no slime ball needed
Right-click your own stage 3+ dragon with an empty hand to mount. Space takes off, X (Dragon Down) descends, R breathes, G strikes, F7 switches the dragon camera; sneak to get off
Elephants (tame with cakes; saddle it, add a chest for storage), giraffes (apples, golden apples or hay), ostriches (seeds; saddle), zebras (tame like a horse; take a chest)
Tame a Naturalist bird with seeds: it rides on your head and gives you slow falling (bird_head_slow_falling on); parrot_flight is on too (effect unverified)
Right-click your tamed mount with the flute to store it; right-click to release it, again to call it back; sneak + right-click releases it for good; sneak + scroll switches between stored mounts
Hold the jump key in the air to glide (less gravity, keeps momentum); belt relic, also adds a charm slot
Sneak + jump to spring the opposite way you're looking; bounces until you stop, with no fall damage; hold jump or sneak before landing to stop bouncing
Keep running and your speed builds for 5 seconds (ground gets slippery as you speed up)
Held, it works like a bucket that stores several liquids (Shift + scroll picks one); worn, you walk on any liquid it holds (slow at first, faster the more of that liquid it stores)
Use it to teleport a few blocks forward; it holds a few charges that refill over time
Walk on air as if it were floor; stand still too long and you fall (with extra fall damage); hold sneak to drop down safely
Move freely through leaves, no fall damage landing on leaves, heal while inside foliage
Hold right-click to run back along the path you just took (up to a few seconds); cooldown equals the time used
Landing on a Farmer's Delight safety net cancels fall damage and bounces you (sneak to land without bouncing)

Farmer's Delight rope (2 straw make 4) is climbable; ties to fences and walls; right-click hanging rope with more rope to extend it down (unverified); sneak + right-click rope with an empty hand reels it back up
Potent Sulfur (9 sulfur, or found in Sulfur Springs) erupts as a geyser that launches anything above it upward; its gas gives Nausea (details unverified)
Towers of the Wild towers (130 Overworld biomes, Nether, End, deep oceans) have a waystone and a loot chest at the top
Towns and Towers villages have a waystone in the square; some Structory: Towers towers and outposts and Dungeons and Taverns shrines have one too
Luki's Grand Capitals villages in five styles, at least 1,100 blocks apart; each town shows its name as you walk in
Dragon caves and roosts never generate within 1,000 blocks of spawn

Barter gold with a Piglin Traveler (camps in Nether wastes and soul sand valleys; travelers don't attack you even without gold armour). The compass points to a random Nether structure (fortress, bastion, ruined portal...) or biome, named in its tooltip ("Locked on to"); no repeat of the same target for a day

Dragon skull over 2 netherite ingots; use it to find the nearest dragon within 150 blocks. Epic Seeker (smithing: netherite template + nether star) 200 blocks; Legendary Seeker (skull over 2 dragonsteel) 300 blocks, wild dragons
A villager in a Dungeons and Taverns tavern is a quest trader: trade with it once and it adds a deal of 14 emeralds + a compass for a map to a Dungeons and Taverns dungeon (details unverified)
In YUNG's strongholds each end portal frame has a 10 % chance to already hold an eye, so you may need fewer eyes of ender (they take Brewing 55)
Sparse Structures doubles the spacing of every structure set (spreadFactor 2): expect to travel further between dungeons

rows.feature: Totems work from the charm slot
rows.how: Put a Totem of Undying, Totem of Freezing or Totem of Illusion in the Curios charm slot (G): it triggers from there, so your off-hand stays free. There is one charm slot (shared with Relics' Experience Disperser); Kinetic or Hunting Belt adds more
Iceologer and Illusioner drops; trigger when a hit takes you below half health (Freezing freezes nearby attackers, Illusion leaves illusions and makes you invisible; exact effects unverified)

Each relic ability has a Targeting tab: choose whether it affects you, hostile/neutral/peaceful mobs, tamed creatures, players on your FTB team and players on other teams. Set damaging abilities to spare your team
Once per cooldown, a lethal hit is cancelled and you go into immortal spectral flight for a few seconds (keeps you from dying and dropping a Heart; interplay with lifesteal unverified)

rows.feature: Leafy Mantle: Gift of the Grove
rows.how: A lethal hit is soaked up by absorbing nearby leaf blocks (each block blocks part of the damage): fight near trees

rows.feature: Ring of the Seven Deadly Sins
rows.how: Seven trade-offs at once: Pride (damage by height difference), Envy, Wrath (hit timing), Sloth (stand still to become immortal, take more damage while moving), Greed (more luck and loot, sometimes destroys loot), Gluttony (stats by hunger), Lust (extra offspring, but bred animals die unless bred again). Read its page before wearing it
Hold right-click to open a parry window that blocks hits from the front; if nothing is parried, the next hit on you does more damage; cooldown after
Invisibility in darkness; damage/attack-speed or health/regen bonus by moon phase (switch Full/New Moon in the Left Alt wheel)
More max health and regeneration in water or rain; stores electric charges that zap whatever you touch (switch off in the Left Alt wheel)
Use it: lose a third of your max health, regain twice that over 10 seconds
Piglins don't attack you first, trades give more, kills drop gold teeth (smelt into gold)

From piglin brutes (10 %) and bastion chests (25 %). Right-click to charge forward for 0.75 s (no turning, jumping or knockback); hitting a mob deals 6-8 and gives Critical Aura (next hit crits); a wall launches you up; no charging when wet; 12 s cooldown. Enchant Turning (steer, longer, weaker) or Bang! (explosion that hurts you too). Hover it and press Sneak for details
Illusioner drop: use it for a burst of invisibility and speed in a cloud (escape tool), with a cooldown
Hallowed Gem over gold and a goat horn: blow it to make nearby monsters glow through walls
Rare Marauder drop: a throwable axe (aim and release like a trident)
Most Illager Invasion illagers (and Friends&Foes' Iceologer and Illusioner) join raids; the Invoker has a boss bar and drops Primal Essence
Sneak + right-click an unemployed villager or nitwit while holding a sword or crossbow: it becomes a guard. Villages spawn 6 guards of their own

Right-click a guard (you need village reputation 15+, Hero of the Village, or to have made it) to open its gear: armour, weapon, off-hand shield or food/potions it uses when hurt; Patrol makes it hold a spot; Follow needs Hero of the Village; ring a bell with Hero to call nearby guards to follow you
rows.docs: MISSING (Hero of the Village named in quests.md, capes.md)

rows.how: Guards and golems attack a player whose village reputation is -100 or lower (e.g. after hurting villagers); guards defend villagers, golems and each other
Clerics heal guards and players with Hero of the Village (3 times a day); armorers/weaponsmiths/toolsmiths repair guards' gear below half durability

rows.feature: Dragon armour needs Dragon Slayer II
rows.how: Dragonscale and dragonsteel armour comes straight off until you finish Dragon Slayer II
A slain dragon stays as a body: right-click it to loot scales, bones and flesh; right-click with glass bottles for dragon blood; the heart and skull drop once per body
rows.docs: PARTIAL: elvarg.md#when-she-falls (the time to loot Elvarg only; how to loot a body MISSING)

rows.how: Dragon bone sword + fire/ice/lightning dragon blood: Flamed, Iced and Lightning Dragon Bone Swords (+8 or +4 damage against the opposite dragons; ignite, freeze or strike lightning). Dragonsteel: fire burns 15 s with big knockback, ice freezes the target in ice

The Ender Dragon isn't there at first: she is summoned when a player gets close to the bell tower in the middle. To fight her again, put 4 end crystals on the 4 bedrock pads inside the tower (one per wing) or on the vanilla spots; a resummoned dragon drops no egg
rows.docs: MISSING (end.md and quests.md give only the vanilla crystal spots)

rows.how: Pale Garden: at night a creaking heart between pale oak logs sends out a creaking that only moves while you're not looking at it and can't be killed while its heart stands; break the heart to end it. Hitting the creaking makes the heart drop resin clumps
In the Nether citadel: four shields to break, shockwaves, summons blazes. Drops Wildfire Crown Fragments; 5 make the Wildfire Crown (helmet)

Bamboo, hills, savannah and snowy creepers only attack if provoked; mushroom creepers are passive; cats and ocelots scare creepers; some blasts poison, blind or reshape the ground; cave creepers can drop raw ores, emeralds or diamonds
Gelid (zombie that freezes), Thicket (zombie that poisons), Verdant (skeleton with poison arrows), Murk (underwater skeleton; shear it for coral); can come from dungeon and trial spawners
Knives swing fast; Backstabbing (knife enchant) multiplies damage on hits from behind, up to level X here
The skillet is a heavy melee weapon with extra knockback
Rhinos charge, hippos attack boats, alligators guard their eggs, bears defend cubs, scorpions poison, sharks and piranhas in water

Flint, iron, golden, diamond or netherite knife: break grass, wheat or rice with it for Straw; kills always give the secondary drop (e.g. leather, feathers); cut Ham from pigs and hoglins; carves pumpkins

Right-click to put an item on the board, then right-click with the right tool: knife for food, axe to strip logs (tree bark), others per JEI's "Cutting Board" category. Fortune on the tool adds 10 % per level to rare results

Set the pot on a stove, magma block or lava cauldron, or over a campfire, fire or lava (it grows a tray); "Needs heat from below" until then. Up to 6 ingredients; the bowl, bottle or bucket the meal is served on goes in the container slot ("Served on"); can't cook while flooded; recipe book on the left

rows.feature: Cooking pot meals need Cooking levels
rows.how: Recipes past your Cooking level stay in the pot's output (soups 10, stews/rice dishes 20, pasta/plated meals 30, feasts 50)
Break a cooking pot with meals inside and the item keeps them (tooltip "Holds N servings of"); place it again to serve

Hold the skillet, hold food in the other hand, stand by heat (campfire, fire, stove, lava) and use it to cook one item at a time; sneak to place it as a block on a heat source and right-click food onto it; Fire Aspect cooks faster
A campfire you can stand pots and skillets on: right-click raw food onto its 6 spots; light it with flint and steel; it burns mobs standing on it

Roast Chicken, Stuffed Pumpkin, Honey Glazed Ham, Shepherd's Pie and Rice Roll Medley place as blocks; right-click with a bowl to take a serving ("You need a Bowl to eat this"); a comparator reads servings left; break the leftovers
Place pies (and cake) and right-click a knife on them for slices, or right-click to eat a bite; breaking a cake with a knife drops slices
Hearty meals (and vanilla soups and stews here) give Nourishment: your hunger bar stops dropping, except when healing from saturation; the hunger bar turns gold while it lasts
Farmer's Delight soups and stews give Comfort (the food tooltip says which): natural regeneration however hungry you are; the hearts shimmer while it lasts
Milk Bottle clears one effect, Hot Cocoa clears one harmful effect, Melon Juice heals a little at once
Mushroom stew, beetroot soup and rabbit stew stack to 16 like Farmer's Delight meals; rabbit stew is stronger

Wild cabbages and beetroots on beaches; carrots and onions in plains and forests; potatoes in cold lands; tomatoes in savannas and deserts; rice in swamp and jungle ponds (JEI's info tab on each crop says so). Saffi in Lemurton sells the seeds
Plant rice in water one block deep over dirt; it grows two blocks tall; harvest rice panicles for rice
Hang rope above a tomato plant and the vine climbs it, growing taller for more tomatoes; breaking it leaves the rope

Dirt, 2 rotten flesh, 2 straw and 4 bone meal (or tree bark): place it and it slowly turns into Rich Soil, faster in sunlight, next to water and next to mushrooms, podzol, mycelium or more compost; a comparator reads its stage

Crops on rich soil get a free bone-meal boost 20 % of growth ticks; till it with a hoe for rich farmland; mushrooms planted on it turn into mushroom colonies; grass, flowers and wild crops are unaffected
On rich soil a mushroom grows into a colony; shear (or use a knife on) a fully grown colony for mushrooms, and it stays
Dog Food buffs a tamed wolf; Horse Feed buffs a tamed mount
Farmers buy Farmer's Delight crops, wandering traders sell its seeds, villages can have compost heaps (free organic compost) and Farmer's Delight crops on their farms

A slain female dragon can drop an egg. Place the egg: a fire egg must sit in fire, an ice egg in water (it freezes into a Frozen Dragon Egg), a lightning egg in the rain under open sky; after 7200 ticks (about 6 minutes) there it hatches (look at it with Jade for the time left). The egg records who placed it (JEI's text says the nearest player bonds with it; which one wins is unverified, so stand next to it)
Feed it raw meat; Dragon Meal (bones and meat) makes it grow fast; Sickly Dragon Meal stops it growing. A stage 1 hatchling climbs onto you when right-clicked; from stage 3 you can ride it

Sneak + right-click your dragon with an empty hand to open its inventory; dragon armour (head, neck, body, tail) is crafted like armour but from metal blocks (iron, copper, silver, gold, diamond, netherite, dragonsteel)
A dragon skull on two sticks: right-click your dragon to cycle Wander, Stay and Escort; sneak + right-click to set its home where it stands (it wanders up to 40 blocks from home) or clear it
Two dragon bones and an iron ingot: blow it to bring your flying dragons within 8 blocks down to the ground
Dragon bones and a stick: right-click your dragon to store it in the horn, use the horn elsewhere to let it out

Dragon blood, ender pearl, diamond and emerald (or sapphire): right-click your dragon to bind it; use the crystal anywhere in the same dimension to teleport the dragon to you; craft it on its own to unbind
Use a vanilla brush on your own dragon for up to 2 dragon scales, with a cooldown: scales without a kill

Fire Lily Mixture (bowl, blaze rod, fire lily), Frost Lily Mixture (bowl, prismarine crystals, frost lily) or the lightning one (recipe unverified): use it on an adult male, then a female; she lays an egg in a nest
Butterflies pollinate flowers and make nearby crops grow, like bees: keep some by your farm (catch them with a Capture Net)
Bamboo and string: right-click butterflies, caterpillars, ants, scorpions, snails, crabs, hedgehogs and rats to catch them as items; use the item to let them out

Birds: seeds. Rats: bread. Snakes: spider eye or rabbit. Lizards: spider eye. Tortoises: bamboo, dandelion, brown mushroom or cactus. Hedgehogs: sweet or glow berries. Capybaras: melon slices. Crabs: tropical fish. Ducks: raw fish. Hippos: melon. Elephants: cake. Giraffes: apples or hay. Ostriches: seeds (from the mod's food tags; tame vs tempt unverified for some)
Copper ingot over string: blow it to switch your tamed Naturalist pets between following and wandering ("X is now Following")
3 hide: catch a baby or small animal in it to carry it and release it elsewhere (which animals unverified)
Smelt hide (boars, elephants, komodo dragons, rhinos) into leather: more leather for saddles, harnesses and backpacks
Snails produce slime balls over time and lay eggs (rate unverified)
Smelt glow berries; place up to 3 in one block as a soft light (works underwater); 8 goop round an arrow make 2 spectral arrows
Rats go after crops (RatHarvestCropsGoal): fence your fields (whether tamed rats also harvest is unverified)
Ducks lay duck eggs (they work in cake and pumpkin pie); ostriches, tortoises, alligators and snails lay egg blocks the parents defend
Tame a glare with glow berries: it follows you and flies to dark spots where mobs can spawn; it also eats glow berries off cave vines
Shear a moobloom for buttercups (yellow dye); mooblooms spread buttercups and draw bees
In mineshafts, a rascal plays hide-and-seek: find it three times and it rewards you with a bundle of loot (sometimes a bad one)
Feed a mauler enchanted items to store their experience; right-click it with glass bottles to get Bottles o' Enchanting back; it grows with the XP it holds (details unverified)
Pigs, cows and chickens come in warm and cold variants by biome; chickens lay blue or brown eggs; any egg works in cake and pumpkin pie

Sulfur Caves slime-like cube: give it a block and it swallows it and takes on that block's behaviour (wood bouncy, ice slides, TNT explodes, magma burns, honey sticks...); shears pop the block out; catch it in a bucket
Hunting Belt: your pets hit harder (higher ranks: pets shield you, a fallen pet leaves a bone that can revive it). Chef's Hat: kills sometimes drop meatballs

Two copper ingots stacked make a copper button. The pulse gets shorter as it oxidizes: 10 ticks (fresh), 7 (exposed), 4 (weathered), 1 (oxidized); wax it with honeycomb to keep its length, scrape with an axe to reset

Stack a copper block, a carved pumpkin and a lightning rod (rod placed last): the copper golem wanders and presses nearby copper buttons at random, a random pulse source. It oxidizes over time and finally freezes as a statue; scrape it with an axe, wax it with honeycomb
Lightning rods now oxidize (exposed, weathered, oxidized and waxed versions)
Macaw's metal doors (metal, hospital, warning, windowed, reinforced) open only with redstone power, like iron doors
Place one garage door block on the ceiling; right-click or a redstone signal rolls it down and up
Half-height redstone lamp
A dispenser holding a knife (or other tool) facing a cutting board uses the tool on the item on the board
Comparators read cooking pots, cabinets, baskets, cutting boards, feasts (servings left), pies and organic compost (stage)
Right-click a rope hanging under a bell to ring it
A comparator reads a creaking heart (stronger the closer its creaking is; vanilla 1.21.4 behaviour, unverified in the backport)

rows.feature: Wooden trapped chests and chiseled bookshelves
rows.how: Woodworks trapped chests in every wood give a signal while open; chiseled bookshelves in every wood give the vanilla comparator reading (the last slot used)

rows.feature: Heat passes through hoppers and chutes
rows.how: A hopper or a Create chute between the heat source and the cooking pot still passes the heat up (Farmer's Delight heat_conductors tag), so the pot can be fed or emptied through the block under it (extraction unverified)
All the tree's logs drop at the block you broke, not up in the canopy
Natural leaves around a felled tree break at once, so saplings and apples drop straight away (player-placed leaves stay)
A tree with more than 200 logs isn't felled at all (action bar: "too big ... max tree size: 200"); chop giant redwoods log by log. Trunks of mixed log types count as separate trees

Felling costs 1 durability per 4 logs (rounded down). A nearly broken Lumber Axe still fells as much as it can and breaks (the pack's "PERCENTAGE" durability mode isn't a FallingTree value, so the mod falls back to NORMAL)
`/fallingtree toggle` (any player) switches whole-tree felling off or on for you only
Crimson and warped trees come down with their wart blocks, mangroves with their roots (they need Woodcutting 60 and 45)

rows.feature: No XP from blocks you placed
rows.how: Breaking a block you placed yourself gives no skill XP (reuse penalty 0 %); such blocks show a red outline when you look at them. Mine fresh ground to train
Project MMO's "owner highlight" shows who placed a block when you look at it (display unverified)

The smithing table is Project MMO's salvage block (sneak + right-click with an item shows "Salvage Block" tips), but the pack defines no salvage results, so you get "You cannot salvage X" (unverified)
Project MMO's vein mining is off; its vein keys are unbound
Labyrinth loot: use it on a block and it reports coal, copper, iron, gold or diamond ore nearby ("Iron found nearby"), with a cooldown

4 Platinum Chunks (pillagers, ravagers, inquisitors) make a Platinum Sheet, an armour-trim material with effects: helmet +20 % XP from kills (Insight), chestplate 1.5x break speed when your tool isn't right for the block (Agility), leggings saturation healing tweak (Endurance, unverified), boots never trample farmland (Featherweight)

Copper blocks, paper, dark oak logs, Primal Essence (Invoker) and a Bottle o' Enchanting. With a Hallowed Gem (diamond, amethyst, Unusual and Illusionary Dust) it raises one enchantment on an item a level past its maximum, using a single-enchantment book at max level. The pack's skill caps still decide whether you can use it (unverified interplay)

Build the 3x3x3 forge: 17 dragonforge bricks (dragon scale blocks + stone bricks), 8 dragon bone blocks, a core (bricks round a dragon heart) and an aperture; hold W over the parts for Create's Ponder build guide. A tame (or chained) dragon of the same element breathes into the aperture: iron ingot + that dragon's blood makes dragonsteel; most other items turn to ash or dragon ice
Dragon bone tools and weapons use witherbone (from wither skeletons) as handles
Inside a YUNG's desert temple you have Mining Fatigue until someone kills the Pharaoh at its end; then it's lifted for good
YUNG's mineshafts end some tunnels in ore deposits (coal up to the odd diamond) and carry chest minecarts, and some TNT minecarts
YUNG's catacombs, undead fortresses and spider caves have mob spawners (combat XP spots)
Food tooltips list the effects they give (Nourishment, Comfort, vanilla foods too)
When a level unlocks something, chat says "You have reached level N in X and unlocked:" with the list
rows.docs: MISSING (skills.md covers the HUD card and fireworks)

rows.how: Its key (Open Glossary) is unbound on purpose: with this pack's biome count it crashes the game; use the inventory skills panel and ESC → Skills instead
Project MMO's on-screen skill list is hidden and its toggle key unbound (the pack's XP tracker replaces it)
Look at a dragon with Jade for its stage, age, gender, owner and hunger, and at a dragon egg for the time until it hatches
3 Manuscripts (dragon den chests) make the Bestiary, Ice and Fire's guide book; a Bestiary Lectern (manuscript over planks) adds pages for more manuscripts
Mods → Ice and Fire → client: "Auto 3rd Person Perspective" is off; press F5/F7 yourself when you mount
Relic pages pick their own GUI scale (Relics config enabledAutoScale on)

A relic page shows quality (1-5 stars, from its rolled stats), level and rank; Rank Up (costs relic levels) resets all levels and points but raises the level cap and unlocks rank modifiers; Reset refunds an ability's upgrade points for XP

Researching an ability: move over the fog to find stars and connect them into the ability's constellation (dots round a star show how many links it needs); a Hint costs XP; then click the unlocked card the shown number of times
rows.docs: MISSING (gear.md mentions only unlocking "with a few clicks")

rows.how: Relics level by using their abilities (each ability's Experience Sources tab); each level gives an upgrade point, spent with player XP on ability levels
Reroll an ability's random stats for player XP (better or worse); at max quality it asks you to hold Shift first
Charm relic: when one relic gains experience, all your worn relics get a share

`/pmmo party create <name>`, `/pmmo party invite <player>` (they click Accept/Decline in chat), `leave`, `list`, `uninvite`: party members within 50 blocks share skill XP (no bonus; how it's split is unverified)
Only Ice and Fire's dragons are on: no other creatures or structures, their items hidden from JEI; dragons can't break blocks, wild or tamed

rows.feature: Ocean towers can hold a Heart of the Sea
rows.how: Towers of the Wild ocean towers (deep oceans) have a chest at the top whose loot table includes a Heart of the Sea (2 of 68 weight, 4-8 rolls); Lootr gives every player their own copy of that chest. That's a second source for the Heart recipe
rows.docs: MISSING (lifesteal.md says Hearts of the Sea are buried treasure only)

rows.how: Piglin Proliferation's fire rings ("Alchemical Fire Pit" etc.: coal over 3 cobblestone/blackstone/cobbled deepslate/end stone/netherrack; soul fire base for soul rings) are craftable thanks to the pack. Light it, then right-click it with a potion: the effect spreads over its light radius for the potion's duration, to everyone in range

With a stack on the cursor, hold right mouse and sweep over slots: one item goes into each slot you pass, and passing a slot again adds another (vanilla fills each slot once). Fastest way to lay out a crafting grid.
With a stack on the cursor, hold left mouse and sweep: every stack of the same item you pass joins the cursor stack.
Holding a stack, hold Shift and sweep with left mouse held: every stack of that item you pass is shift-clicked to the other inventory.

rows.feature: Shift + left-drag with an empty cursor
rows.how: Hold Shift, hold left mouse and sweep over slots: each slot you pass is shift-clicked. Inventory Essentials ("Transfer on Hover", enableShiftDrag on) and IPN (swipe moving, on) do the same, so it works in nearly every screen.

Hover a stack and scroll down: its items move one at a time to the other inventory; scroll up: that item is pulled in from the other inventory; fast scrolling moves several. Mods -> Mouse Tweaks -> Config (Mouse Tweaks Options): Wheel Tweak, Scroll Direction (normal, inverted, inventory-position aware), Search Order, Scroll Scaling.

Also on, with fixed directions: wheel up over a stack sends one item from your inventory into the open container, wheel down sends one from the container to you. Hold Left Shift = whole stack, Z = leave one behind, X = spread over the free slots, C = throw it out, Left Ctrl = scrolling off while held. With an item on the cursor the wheel hands out single items from it and picks up the next stack when it runs out.

Over a container's slots IPN and Mouse Tweaks agree; over your own slots they push opposite ways (unverified which acts). If the wheel misbehaves, turn one off: IPN Settings (R+C) -> Features -> Enable Item Scrolling, or Mouse Tweaks Options -> Wheel Tweak, or untick Mouse Tweaks on the launcher's Mods page (it is optional).
Ctrl + left-click a stack moves a single item to the other inventory.

rows.feature: Ctrl + Shift + click: move every stack of a kind
rows.how: Moves all stacks of that item to the other side (all the cobblestone out of a chest at once). Not listed in Controls (a combined-modifier binding).
Hold Space and left-click any item: everything in that inventory moves to the other side. Clicking an empty slot does nothing (allowBulkTransferAllOnEmptySlot off).
Moves one of every item in that inventory to the other side. The config text says Ctrl+Space; the shipped binding is Space + right-click.
Space-clicking a piece of armour moves the whole matching set (bulkTransferArmorSets on) (unverified).

rows.feature: Ctrl + Shift + Q: drop a whole kind
rows.how: Over a slot, drops every stack of that item from that inventory.
Holding a stack, Shift + left-click outside the window drops it and every other stack of that item (unverified exact rule).

Unbound; bind in Controls -> Inventory Essentials. Restock Container tops up the container's stacks from you, Restock Inventory tops up yours from it, Dump to Container empties your inventory into it (unverified). IPN's Move All covers most of this already.
The pack unbinds Inventory Essentials' middle-click sort so it can't fight the backpack's; middle-click sorts Sophisticated backpack screens only. Elsewhere use IPN's buttons or R.

rows.feature: IPN keys are not in Controls
rows.how: IPN has its own key system: hold R and press C to open its settings, then the Hotkeys page (left-click a binding to change it, right-click to reset). Defaults: R sort, R+T Move All, R+M Throw All, R+G button editor; Left Alt + click locks slots; the scroll modifiers above.

R is IPN's Sort in any container screen (it sorts the side under the cursor) and JEI's Show Recipe over an item. Point at an empty slot to sort; over an item JEI opens the recipe (unverified whether IPN also sorts then).

rows.feature: Ctrl + click on hotbar or armour slots
rows.how: Ctrl + left-click on a hotbar or armour slot also toggles IPN's Auto Refill for that slot, and the pack hides IPN's per-slot markers, so a slot can quietly stop refilling. Ctrl+click it again, or show the markers: IPN Settings -> Auto Refill -> Show Icons on Enabled Slots (unverified that both mods react to one click). In game, Left Ctrl + R toggles refill for the held slot.
Settings -> Controls -> Key Binds has a search box.

In that search: `key:g` lists everything on G, `category:jei` and `name:sort` filter (auto-complete suggests terms). Buttons: Show Conflicts (only clashing keys), Show Unbound, Available Keys (a keyboard map of free keys), sort A to Z or by key.

Off by default: launcher -> Mods -> Controlify (Controller support) on, then Play. A controller then drives menus, a snapping inventory cursor, an on-screen keyboard, a radial menu for spare actions, vibration and gyro aiming; its settings are reached from the game's Controls options (unverified location).
Sort, Sort in columns, Sort in rows buttons on your inventory and containers.
Press R in any container screen, your inventory or a backpack: the side under the mouse is sorted.

rows.feature: A chest gets one set of sort buttons
rows.how: IPN's "Show 2 Sets of Sort Buttons" is off, so with a chest open only the chest has Sort/Columns/Rows; your half only has the Move All arrow. Sort your own inventory there with R over it, or turn the option on (IPN Settings -> Gui Settings). keybinds.md#sorting says each half has its own buttons: check in game.

Scroll the mouse wheel over the Sort button to change its order: Default (creative menu order), Item Name, Item ID, Item Numerical ID, Count descending or ascending, Custom rule. Columns and Rows sort, then group each item into columns or rows.
The arrow empties the container into you or you into it; the hotbar stays put.

Hold while clicking the arrow (or press R+T over a side): Left Shift = only items the other side already has (the pack makes "everything" the default), Left Alt = include the hotbar, Left Ctrl = only the item type under or on the cursor, Caps Lock = only top up stacks that are already there.
R+M over an inventory throws its items on the floor: only matching ones by default, everything with Left Shift (unverified match rule). Dangerous on a PvP server.

Hold Left Alt and left-click a slot (inventory or hotbar) to lock or unlock it (red background). Sort, Move All and Throw All skip it; Shift-click, Ctrl+Q and Q can't move or drop it; in game Q won't drop a non-stackable item from a locked hotbar slot (no pickaxe in the lava); empty locked slots don't fill with picked-up items. Saved per server. Auto Refill may still take from locked slots ("Use Items From Locked Slots" is on).
Tops up a hotbar stack that runs out and swaps a tool for a spare before it breaks.

The green tick under the crafting arrow (inventory and crafting table) is IPN's and starts ticked: after you take a result the grid refills from your inventory, so you can keep clicking. Untick it to stop. Hold Left Alt for Auto Crafting: IPN keeps crafting until the ingredients run out (unverified gesture).
Hover an item and every slot with the same item lights up (IPN Settings -> Mod Settings -> Highlight Same as Focused Item).
In an anvil, tick IPN's Bulk Rename box to rename every stack of that item in your inventory at once (unticked each time you open the anvil).

IPN's equipment profiles (swap armour and tools as one set) are off in this pack. Turn on: IPN Settings -> Mod Settings -> Enable Equipment Profiles Support, and Gui Settings -> Enable Profiles Switching Gui. Then R+P saves what you wear as a profile, R+Z / R+X next or previous, R+1 to R+0 quick profiles. A pack update that ships a new IPN config may reset these settings.

Hover a shulker box (or any item that holds items) and hold Left Shift for a compact preview, Left Shift + Left Alt for the full slot layout, Left Ctrl to freeze the tooltip. An ender chest item previews your own ender chest (server integration is on).
G, or the small button on your character in the inventory, opens the Curios panel: Head, Necklace, Back, Cape, Belt, Hands (2), Ring, Charm, Feet (2).
rows.docs: MISSING (G in keybinds.md, Cape slot in capes.md, relic slots in gear.md#relics)

rows.how: The eye on a Curios slot hides that item on your character without taking it off.

rows.feature: One Back slot for backpack or mantle
rows.how: Backpacks and the Relics mantles (Midnight, Leafy, Glitchy, Ghostly) share the single Back slot. Only a worn backpack runs its upgrades, so wearing a mantle turns your backpack's magnet, pickup and feeding off.
Engineer's Goggles fit the Curios Head slot, so you can wear goggles and a helmet together.

Leather: 4 string, 4 leather and a chest. Then each tier surrounds the last with its Create age's parts: copper = 6 copper sheets + 2 andesite alloy; iron = 6 iron sheets + 2 andesite casings; gold = 6 golden sheets + 2 brass casings; diamond = 6 diamonds + 2 precision mechanisms; netherite = smithing table (template + netherite ingot). Contents and upgrades come along.
rows.docs: MISSING (Backpack Workshop chapter named in quests.md)

rows.how: Storage slots / upgrade slots: leather 18/1, copper 27/1, iron 36/2, gold 54/2, diamond 72/3, netherite 90/4 (about two thirds of the mod's own).

Put the backpack in the Curios Back slot (G); the chest armour slot also works but costs your chestplate. Only the worn backpack runs active upgrades (magnet, pickup, feeding, smelting, refill...); any others you carry are plain storage.
Carrying a 4th backpack gives Slowness, one level for each extra backpack.
B, or ESC -> Backpack.
Right-click a backpack in your hand, or hover any backpack in an inventory screen and press B. With no worn backpack, B opens the first one you carry (unverified order).
Hover a backpack and hold Left Shift to list its upgrades and contents.
Sneak + right-click a block with the backpack in hand places it; right-click opens it; sneak + right-click it with an empty hand picks it up (breaking it also keeps the contents inside).
Type in the backpack screen's search field to show only matching slots; start with @ to search by mod.
Middle-click (or the sort button) sorts the backpack; the button beside it cycles By Name, By Mod, By Count, By Tags.

[ moves the items the backpack already holds from your inventory into it, ] moves them back out; hold Shift to move everything. Same as the two arrow buttons. These work in backpack screens only (keybinds.md says "in menus").

Upgrades go in the backpack's upgrade slots; each one adds a tab at the side with its filters and options, and an ON/OFF switch. Alt+Z / Alt+X switch the first two on and off, slots 3 to 5 can be bound in Controls.
Most upgrades start from an Upgrade Base (4 string, 4 iron ingots, 1 leather); the advanced version is made from the basic one. JEI (R / U) shows every recipe.
Put an upgrade alone in a crafting grid to wipe its filters and settings (an Ender Linker the same way to unlink it).

One stack upgrade per backpack, at most Tier 2 (x4); one furnace-type upgrade (smelting, smoking, blasting or an auto one); one jukebox; one tool swapper; one everlasting. Disabled: stack Tier 3, Tier 4, Omega and their conversions; Inception (no backpacks in backpacks); pump, advanced pump, battery, mob catcher, infinity. Shulker boxes and other item containers can't go in a backpack, and a backpack can't go in a shulker box or bundle.

Starter x1.5, Tier 1 x2, Tier 2 x4 (pack recipe: 4 gold blocks and 4 brass casings around a Tier 1). Conversion items upgrade one already installed: right-click it in its slot. Shift-click takes one normal stack out of an oversized slot, Ctrl+Shift+click as much as fits (unverified which wins against Inventory Essentials' Ctrl+Shift+click).

While worn, items you pick up go straight into the backpack (a placed backpack collects items that touch it). Filter of 9 items (Allow or Block); Advanced: 16 slots, match by mod, tag, NBT or durability, or "Match Backpack Contents" (only what's already inside).

Pulls dropped items within 3 blocks into the worn or placed backpack (Advanced: 4 blocks, cut from the mod's 5), with the same filters. With a Tank Upgrade it also soaks up XP orbs ("Pickup Experience").

Hold the backpack and sneak + right-click a chest, or wear it, look at the chest and press C: Deposit moves the filtered items into the chest ("Match Inventory Contents" = only what the chest already has), Restock pulls the filtered items from the chest into the backpack. Chat says how many stacks moved.

Keeps the items in its filter (6; Advanced 12) topped up in your inventory from the worn backpack: torches, food or building blocks never run out. Advanced: per item, the slot to fill (Any, Main hand, Off hand or hotbar 1 to 9; scroll the target button).

Turns filtered items into their compressed form as they come in: Basic 2x2 recipes only, Advanced 2x2 and 3x3 (nuggets to ingots, ingots to blocks). By default only compacts what can be crafted back ("Compact Anything" changes that); "Works in GUI as well" also compacts what you put in by hand.

Deletes filtered items as they come in (cobblestone, gravel, rotten flesh). Modes: Void Always, Void Slot Overflow (keeps one slot's worth), Void Storage Overflow; "Works in GUI as well" decides whether items you put in by hand are voided too.

Smelting, Smoking and Blasting add a furnace tab (smoking and blasting are twice as fast for their own items). The Auto versions take fuel and items from the backpack by filter and put the results back. One per backpack; it has to be worn to run.
A 3x3 crafting tab that keeps its items when closed; JEI's [+] fills it; options: shift-click the result into the backpack or your inventory, refill the grid from the backpack.
Anvil tab (repair, rename, combine; XP cost as usual) and Smithing tab (templates, netherite) without placing the blocks.

Tank Upgrade turns the last row(s) of slots into a fluid tank (4,000 mB per row of slots; fill and drain with buckets in its tab, or buckets and pipes on a placed backpack; at most two). Experience Pump (needs a tank) stores your XP as liquid: store or take N levels, or keep you at a level. Its Mending repair is switched off here.
Play music discs from the backpack (Advanced: 12 discs, shuffle and repeat).

The backpack can't burn, explode, be pricked by cactus or despawn; it floats on lava and stops above the void. On this server: if you die without Grave Essence, a dropped everlasting backpack waits on the ground (for you, or whoever finds it first).

Backpack Settings -> Memory: left-click or drag over slots so they remember their item and accept only that item, so sorting and pickups keep everything in place. Right-click or drag to clear; Select All / Unselect All buttons.
Backpack Settings -> No Sort: the slots you select are skipped when the backpack is sorted.

The settings button on the backpack opens Backpack Settings: Backpack or Player context (Player applies to all your backpacks), Shift Click Into Open Tab First, Keep Tab Open, Keep Search Phrase, and save or load these settings to numbered slots (scroll to pick one).
Backpack Settings -> Item Display: choose a slot whose item is shown on the front of the placed backpack (rotate, depth, colour, side). A label for placed storage.
Craft it with dyes: dyes left of the backpack colour the main cloth, right of it the trim, in the same column both; add more dye to blend; right-click a water cauldron to wash it.

Recipe: 5 obsidian, 2 ender pearls, 2 blaze rods. Right-click a backpack with it (or craft them together) to bind it, then right-click or craft an empty backpack with the bound linker: both now open the same inventory wherever they are; the second one takes the first one's size (unverified details).

rows.feature: Others can open the backpack on your back
rows.how: The server allows it and every backpack starts with "Another player can open": anyone who right-clicks your back opens the backpack you're wearing and can take what's inside. Turn it off: open the backpack -> settings button -> Another player can NOT open (in the Player context it covers all your backpacks).

rows.feature: Jade shows what's in a chest
rows.how: Looking at a chest, barrel, shulker box, furnace or other container shows its first 9 items (Left Shift for more), straight from the server: others can see what your chests hold without opening them, and you theirs. Jade Settings (Keypad 0) -> Plugins -> Item Storage only hides it on your own screen.

rows.feature: Health, armour and effects at a glance
rows.how: Looking at a mob or player shows its health and armour as icons and its status effects; bosses too.

Uses potions, splash potions, effect foods and milk from the worn backpack on a condition: Keep Active, When on Fire, When Under Water, When Falling, When Sprinting, When Affected by Negative Effect, When Mining, When Hurt below N health (scroll to set N). Advanced: match duration or amplifier, and "any effect missing" or "all effects missing".
IPN replaces an armour piece at 10 durability left with a spare of the same kind from your inventory, with a warning first (Auto Refill -> Refill Armor Before It Breaks).
FTB Teams has no friendly-fire setting: party members and allies can still hit each other (unverified).
Every food's tooltip shows the hunger and saturation it gives (always on, no Shift needed).

The hunger bar shows your saturation as a gold outline and exhaustion as a faint bar behind it; holding food previews the hunger, saturation and health it would restore (flashing icons); F3 lists the numbers.

Eats food from the worn backpack when you get hungry; its filter decides which foods (keep rotten flesh and pufferfish out). Advanced: feed when a little hungry, half hungry or only when nothing is wasted, and "Feed player immediately when hurt".
U on a food (or a mob's page) opens JEI pages Breeding, Taming, Temper, Trusting and Transformation: what each mob eats to breed or be tamed, eggs it lays, "(tamed)" if it must be tamed first.
U on an emerald opens JEI's Professions page: every villager profession and the workstation block that gives it (hold Shift to see the mod).

In a villager's trade screen hover a trade and press B (bookmark it for every villager of that profession) or L (this villager only); T makes every globally bookmarked trade as often as your items allow, Shift+T the local ones; matching buttons appear in the screen.
Look at a crop or sapling to see its growth in percent.

Looking at an animal shows a baby's time to grow up, the breeding cooldown, time to the next egg or scute, a horse's jump height and speed, a pet's owner; beehives show bees and honey, villagers their profession.

R or U on an ore -> JEI's World Generation page: the heights it generates at (graph), the biomes (click for the full list), vein size and attempts per chunk, and what it drops with Fortune or Silk Touch. Reads the server's real world generation.
Look at a block: Jade names the tool that breaks it with a tick or cross for whether your held tool can, and shows breaking progress (unverified whether the tick follows the pack's Hardness tiers).

IPN swaps a tool at 10 durability left for a spare of the same kind, after a few hotbar-flash and sound warnings; nothing happens (only a warning) if you carry no spare. Settings: IPN Settings -> Auto Refill (Damage Threshold, alerts).

rows.feature: Let a tool break on purpose
rows.how: Hold Left Alt while using it: IPN's tool replacement is paused.
Inventory Essentials also replaces a tool that broke and a block stack that ran out from your inventory (Enable Tool Refill / Enable Stack Refill, on).

Left-click a block or mob with the wrong tool and the worn backpack swaps the right one into your hand. Advanced: filters, Swap Weapon / Swap Tools modes, and the "Swap tool based on current block/entity" key (unbound) for wrench-type tools. One per backpack.
With an Advanced Refill Upgrade in the worn backpack, middle-click (pick block) on a block takes that block from the backpack into your hand.
A stonecutter tab in the backpack; it remembers the last recipe and picks it again for the same input.
2 cobblestone over 3 dirt craft a Grave block; name it in an anvil and the name is written on it.
Looking at redstone shows the power level, a repeater's delay, a comparator's mode and its input signal.
A placed backpack gives a comparator signal by how full it is.
A comparator on a Lootr chest or barrel always reads 1, whatever is inside.

A placed backpack is an inventory for hoppers, funnels and mechanical arms. A Filter Upgrade sets what may go in or out (Allow / Block list, Match Backpack Contents) and the direction (Input, Output, Input & Output).
Stack Downgrade Tier 1 / 2 / 3 divide slot size by 8 / 16 / 32 (they multiply together), so a placed backpack holds only a few of each item: a small buffer.

Blaze burner heat and fuel time left, a filter's contents, a placard's item, a backtank's air, the exact block on a contraption. "Integrate Goggles" (off; Jade Settings -> Plugins) puts Create's goggle readout into Jade's panel.
Place one Ender-linked backpack at base on a funnel and wear its twin: anything you put in the worn one can be pulled into your base storage (unverified).

R+C, the small IPN button at the top left of container screens, or Mods -> Inventory Profiles Next -> Config. Pages: Mod Settings, Gui Settings (which buttons show, two sets of sort buttons, sort orders), Auto Refill, Locked Slots, Item Scrolling, Hotkeys, Tweaks.
R+G (or IPN's small editor button) opens its overlay editor: Space / Shift+Space pick a button, WASD or arrows move it (Shift for faster), or tell IPN to ignore a screen.
R over an item shows its recipes, U its uses (also left / right click in JEI's list).

Click JEI's search bar (or Ctrl+F). Words match item names and tooltips; `@create` = from a mod; `#c:ingots` = in a tag; `$word` = tooltip text only; `-word` excludes; `a\|b` = either; "two words" = one phrase. Up / Down arrows recall earlier searches. Colour (^), id (&) and creative-tab (%) searches are off.

A over an item adds it to the bookmark list on the left (A again removes it; drag to reorder). On a recipe page, A over the output (or the recipe's bookmark button) bookmarks the recipe: hold Ctrl over it to preview, Shift+click to craft one, Ctrl+click to craft as many as you can (unverified: needs an open crafting grid). Bookmarked and craftable recipes are listed first.

On a recipe page the [+] beside the recipe moves the ingredients from your inventory into the open grid (inventory 2x2, crafting table, a backpack's Crafting Upgrade); Shift+click fills as many sets as you have; a red [+] lists what's missing.
Drag an item from JEI's list onto a filter slot (backpack upgrade filters, Create filters) to set it without owning the item.
The `i` tab on an item's recipe page: how to get it, where it's found.
Ctrl+O shows or hides JEI's panels.

There's no in-game JEI settings screen (its config button asks for the Configured mod): edit config/jei/jei-client.ini in the game folder, e.g. [lookupHistory] enabled = true for a recently-looked-up list.
Click an active effect in your inventory's effect list (or an effect icon in JEI) for its Effects page: what it does, beneficial / neutral / harmful, its colour, and which foods and items give it.
Jade's panel at the top of the screen toggles with Keypad 1, so press it if Jade disappeared. No keypad: rebind Show Overlay in Controls -> Jade.

Keypad 0 (or Mods -> Jade -> Config): display mode Toggle / Hold / Lite (Lite shows more only while Left Shift is held), what each plugin shows, coordinates and distance (off), theme. Its position and size are set in HUD Layout.

Look at a furnace, smoker, blast furnace or brewing stand for its input, fuel and output; a jukebox shows its disc, a note block its note and instrument, a lectern its book, item frames and armour stands their items.
The last line of every item tooltip names the mod it comes from.
Every enchantment on a book or item has a short grey description under it (always on).

Rare and epic items get a decorated frame and shine, names are centred over a separator, armour and tools show a slowly turning 3D model. The "Scroll Tooltips" key (Left Shift) has nothing to do while tooltip scrolling stays at its default, Never (unverified).
With advanced tooltips on (F3+H), hold Left Shift for an item's item / block / entity tags, Left Alt for its changed components, Alt+Shift for all of them; fuels show their burn time on Shift.

Top left of the inventory: FTB's buttons, My Team (team screen) and Quests (quest book), plus FTB Library settings; operators also get time, weather and gamemode toggles (unverified for non-operators). Right-click to rearrange them.
rows.mod: FTB Library, FTB Teams, FTB Quests

rows.how: Type anywhere on the index to search; Add Bookmark pins a page to the front (Shift-click a bookmark to remove it); History lists recent pages; Back (Shift-click: home); the Resize button changes the book's size.
If a menu bar suddenly appears on the title or ESC screen, Ctrl+Alt+C hides FancyMenu's editor bar again; Ctrl+Alt+R reloads the menus.
; (semicolon), ESC -> Team, or My Team at the top left of the inventory.
Everyone starts in a team of one. In the team screen click Create a Party and give it a name (description and colour optional). A party shares quest progress.
The owner or an officer clicks Invite Player(s) and picks online players; the invitee gets a chat message with Accept and Decline buttons.
In the team screen, members can be promoted to officer, demoted, kicked or made owner; Leave Party and Disband Party. The owner must hand over ownership before leaving.
Manage Allies marks other players as allies of your team (an FTB Teams rank; see Combat & PvP for PvP).
The chat toggle in the team screen sends your normal chat to your party only (toggle again for public chat). `/ftbteams msg <text>` sends one team message (unverified syntax).
`/ftbteams party create <name>`, `/ftbteams party invite <player>`, `/ftbteams party join <team>`, `/ftbteams party leave`, `/ftbteams info` (unverified exact syntax).
Team properties -> Free to Join lets players join without an invite.

The Gravestone config leaves "only owners can break" off: any player who breaks your grave gets its items straight into their own inventory. Get back to it first. world.md says only you (or a teammate with permission) can open it, which this setting contradicts.
Your items go back into the slots they were in (armour worn, hotbar as it was); anything that doesn't fit drops.

A death with a grave hands you an Obituary: right-click it for the place (X, Y, Z and dimension), the date, a picture of you as you died and every item you had. It's never owned; keep it until you're back.
Right-click a grave to see whose it is and when they died; Jade shows the same when you look at it.
Explosions don't destroy graves and mobs such as withers can't break them (from the code; unverified in game).
Everyone who opens a structure's chest gets their own loot.
Lootr containers look gold until you open them and blue after, for you; each player's loot is rolled separately.
Hitting a Lootr container only gives a warning; it breaks while sneaking, and then it's gone for everyone and drops none of the loot. Explosions can still destroy them.
Mineshaft chest minecarts, structure item frames (an End ship's elytra frame gives every player an elytra), decorated pots and suspicious sand and gravel are per player too.
Open 100 Lootr containers for the Centennial advancement and its trophy.
ESC -> Quests; Ctrl + wheel zooms, drag pans; click a quest to read it and claim its rewards.

Open a quest and click Pin: it and its tasks appear in the tracker at the right edge (move it with HUD Layout). The Auto-pin button pins every quest you can do in the current chapter. "Pinned Quest Tracker Visibility" (unbound) cycles quests and tasks / quests only / hidden.
Rewards wait for you (auto-claim is off except in the NPC questlines): the book's collect-rewards button claims every finished quest's rewards at once; a crate reward rolls when claimed.
Item tasks only check what you carry: nothing is consumed and there's no Submit step.
Some steps are a checkmark: click it in the quest window to tick it.
Later quests' tasks count before the earlier quest is done, but the quest only completes once the quests before it are; the tracker hides quests that can't complete yet.
Ctrl+P in the book: tracker position, scale and visibility, completion and reward notices as toast, chat, action bar or none, sounds.
The wheel scrolls up and down, Shift + wheel sideways; Backspace reopens the quest you looked at before; F1 on a quest shows extended info.
In a party everyone gets the quest and can claim its rewards.
A dialog button that says "You don't meet the requirements for this option yet" needs a quest step or skill you don't have.
IPN's sort buttons and scrolling and Mouse Tweaks' drags are switched off in vendor shops and the /trade window on purpose: there every click buys, sells or offers.

Crash Assistant's window opens: it lists the crash report and logs, explains known causes (out of memory, graphics driver, a mod conflict) and has an upload-all button that copies one link: send that link to an admin. The pack hasn't set its own support link, so the window shows placeholder "example Discord" text.
rows.docs: MISSING (faq.md covers the launcher's crash view only)

rows.how: It warns when the game runs on a laptop's integrated graphics while a dedicated card exists, with a one-click fix.
Nearby XP orbs merge into one and are absorbed the moment you touch them.
F3 + G toggles chunk borders. Useful because Create Ore Excavation veins are one per chunk, and for laying out farms and machines
F3 + H: item ids, durability numbers, and (this pack) whose item it is
F3 + B shows entity hitboxes (aim, find a mob in the dark)
F3 + Q prints every F3 combination in chat
Controls > LemurSaucePacket > Edit HUD layout (unbound); also ESC → HUD Layout and `/hudlayout`
However many coins you have they're one item; the slot shows 2.3k/45k/1.2M, the tooltip the exact amount; coins you walk over merge in even with a full inventory
Right-click a coin stack in a menu takes half; carrying coins, right-click a slot puts one down; left-click merges
Shift + right-click a coin stack: type 1500, 1,500, 1.5k or 2m (there's an All button)
Right-click opens the whole stack (100 coins a pouch); keep some, mission rerolls cost pouches
An item is yours the first time it enters your inventory, forever; owned items of different owners don't stack together (sorting merges matching ones)
Ore/gems you can't mine yet can sit in a chest/barrel/shulker/ender chest or be dropped; recipes, machines, hoppers, backpacks and other containers refuse them until your Mining level

Right-click a block face: extends it with up to 32 matching blocks taken from your inventory, over the connected same-kind blocks that have air in front; 1 durability per block; not on block entities or shulkers; respects safe zones; pays Construction XP. Crafting 30 (mechanical crafting: brass, precision mechanism, schematicannon core)
rows.docs: PARTIAL: gear.md#tools (the same-kind face, 1 durability a block and no-block-entity rules MISSING)

rows.how: Blocks pay XP after standing 60 s, once per spot; fancier blocks pay more; natural ground, machines, containers, redstone, rails, torches, scaffolding pay 0
0.1% per level that a placed building block isn't used up (~10% at 99); a saved block drops nothing when broken
Crafting-table recipes at Construction 5-70 (10 stone bricks from 8 stone + clay, mossy/cracked/chiseled without a furnace, 8 stairs from 6, cheaper lantern)

Construction 99 cape kit: right-click air to open the picker (it has a search box), pick a block, right-click to place unlimited; middle-click a block to pick that kind; Gerta sells a replacement, `/palette buy`, 10,000 coins
No building, breaking, fluids, fire or PvP inside the walls; no mob spawns; doors/chests/waystones/shops work
Given on first login; chat says distance and direction; Lemurton is 400-700 blocks from spawn
Everyone has it from the start; warp back from any waystone, warp stone or scroll
No /home /tpa /spawn: waystones, trains, airships, horses, happy ghasts

rows.feature: Map to the Stronghold / Map to Crandor
rows.how: Quest compasses (Dragon Slayer I / II) pointing at the stronghold nearest Lemurton / Crandor's memorial
+0.01% speed per level, -0.5% fall damage per level (max 50%); elytra at Agility 30
Relic: step up full blocks, speed burst per ledge; Crafting 20 to make, Agility 25 to wear
No fall damage, even alone; full set +15% speed, step-up, faster swimming
Each town's name shows on screen as you walk in
